comment: High/critical advisories accepted in CI (T-006). Each one sits inside Expo, Firebase or Jest with no fix that keeps SDK 57. Review on every Expo SDK upgrade and remove entries that no longer appear.

advisories.reason: Firestore is not used (we use RTDB, ADR-005); grpc-js is never loaded.
Ships in the app. Denial of service only: a crafted link could hang that one phone, with no data exposed. The fix is a major version that query-string 7 doesn't allow. Review at T-017.
